verdict.rationale: Rive documents an open-source runtime library and a CLI that lets an agent generate Rive content (rive-docs-26, rive-gh-1), which could theoretically be scripted into a CI pipeline, but there is no explicit documentation of headless/CI execution, automated rendering pipelines, or test automation workflows. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless execution docs, examples of automated pipeline integration, confirmation that the CLI/runtime can run without a display or editor session.
